==Description==
'''Popcorn''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that is obtained upon reaching Rank 8 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]]. It was made by CapraKinetics. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 8 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]], which had a cost of {{Pumpkins|2,000 Pumpkins}} or {{Robux|500}} at that rank. The total Robux cost to buy all ranks from Rank 1 to Rank 8 was {{Robux|1,600}}.

==Trivia==
*The walking animation for this emote is the same as your own animation pack.
**Like any other moveable emote, you can use Roblox emotes (such as "/e dance") while using '''Popcorn'''.
*The render for this emote, alongside [[Charleston]] and [[The Z Step]], are the only ones to use a different face.
**The face of the icon is also the same face used for the [[Minigunner/Gallery|Party Minigunner]] skin.
